bureau: Credit Reference Center of the People's Bank of China
note: The State Council's Regulation on the Administration of Credit Investigation Industry (2013), article 16: a credit bureau keeps a person's adverse information five years from the day the adverse act or event ends, then deletes it. No source states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: 国务院, 征信业管理条例 (国务院令第631号), State Council Gazette 2013
sources.said: 征信机构对个人不良信息的保存期限，自不良行为或者事件终止之日起为5年；超过5年的，应当予以删除。
